    idx=l.find('Instance:')

from pathlib import Path
import re
lines=Path('experiment-data/yahoo-128k.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').splitlines()
pat=re.compile(r'\b(boyfriend|girlfriend|husband|wife|marriage|marry|dating|divorce|relationship|ex-boyfriend|ex-girlfriend|love him|love her|my crush|propose|wedding|break up|broke up|cheating|affair)\b', re.I)
n=0
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    if not l.startswith('Date:'): continue
    idx=l.find('Instance:')
    q=l[idx+9:] if idx>=0 else l
    if pat.search(q):
        n+=1
        print(f'{i}|{q.strip()[:120]}')
print('TOTAL_MATCHES', n)
"
